faq.question: What is in the KLOW blend?
faq.answer: KPV 10 mg, BPC-157 10 mg, TB-500 10 mg and GHK-Cu 50 mg per vial (80 mg total), 10 vials per kit, price-list code KLOW80.

faq.question: How does KLOW differ from GLOW?
faq.answer: KLOW adds the α-MSH fragment KPV to the three components of GLOW (BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu), so it suits designs that also address inflammatory-signalling endpoints.

faq.question: Is component documentation provided?
faq.answer: Yes — analytical documentation covers each of the four peptides in the blend.

faq.question: Can I order single vials to evaluate the formulation?
faq.answer: Kits are supplied as 10 vials. For evaluation quantities of individual components, we recommend the single-peptide listings, which are also cheaper per mg.
